articles.title: Jaborandi terá vasos gigantes de 9,6 metros no Centro de Lazer | G1
articles.standfirst: Idealizado pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida e realizado pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi, projeto prevê três grandes vasos, museu e novas estruturas de lazer, esporte e turismo.
articles.summary: Idealizado pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida e realizado pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi, projeto prevê três grandes vasos, museu e novas estruturas de lazer, esporte e turismo.
articles.body:
Início das obras em 2026 dos vasos e museu — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação.

A cidade de Jaborandi está transformando o Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida em um complexo que reúne esporte, lazer, cultura e novos atrativos turísticos. Entre os projetos em execução está a construção de três grandes vasos, com 9,60 metros de altura cada, uma iniciativa idealizada pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida e realizada pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi.

Os vasos prometem se tornar um dos principais símbolos do novo espaço. O projeto prevê estruturas com 9,30 metros de diâmetro, construídas em concreto armado com fechamento em placa cimentícia.

Além das dimensões, uma das características que chama a atenção é a possibilidade de os visitantes entrarem nos vasos e subirem até o topo. Cada estrutura contará com uma escada interna, permitindo o acesso ao ponto mais alto.

A ideia faz parte de um projeto mais amplo de transformação do Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida, que vem recebendo diferentes investimentos para ampliar suas estruturas de esporte, lazer, cultura e turismo.

O projeto arquitetônico dos vasos já foi desenvolvido e conta com imagens em 3D da proposta. Algumas alterações foram realizadas durante a execução. A obra já foi iniciada e a previsão é de conclusão no primeiro semestre de 2027.

O projeto do Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida reúne diferentes espaços e, por isso, sua dimensão é dividida em quatro áreas principais.

A Área do Lago possui aproximadamente 30 mil metros quadrados e concentra estruturas voltadas ao lazer e à convivência. Já a Área Esportiva , com cerca de 23 mil metros quadrados, reúne a areninha, quadras, campo de grama, pista de corrida e a área do ginásio.

A terceira área é destinada ao museu, com aproximadamente 5.700 metros quadrados. O espaço está em construção e integra o projeto de ampliação das opções culturais do município.

A quarta área é a dos vasos, com aproximadamente 12 mil metros quadrados, onde também estão sendo executados serviços de calçamento e paisagismo.

Projetos 3d — Foto: Crédito: Divulgação.

A transformação do Centro de Lazer está sendo realizada pela Prefeitura de Jaborandi, com investimentos estaduais, federais e municipais. Até o momento, são aproximadamente R$4,5 milhões em recursos estaduais e federais e R$ 3,1 milhões em investimentos municipais.

Os recursos já contemplaram ou estão sendo destinados a uma série de intervenções, como a construção de galerias, revitalização e remodelação do lago, construção da prainha, reforma da pista de caminhada, reforma da pista de corrida e das quadras, além da iluminação das pistas.

Também fazem parte do conjunto de obras a construção da areninha, a continuidade do ginásio de esportes, reforma dos vestiários, construção do museu e dos vasos, calçamento e paisagismo das áreas dos vasos e do museu, construção de banheiros, novas quadras de beach tennis, reforma do bar do lago e construção de estacionamento na Rua Abraão Abdala Azura.

O projeto reúne ainda obras executadas com recursos municipais, incluindo a continuidade do ginásio, os vestiários, banheiros e as quadras de beach tennis.

A transformação do Centro de Lazer não termina com as obras que estão em andamento. Há aproximadamente R$1,5 milhão em recursos estaduais previstos em projetos futuros, destinados à construção de um lago ornamental, iluminação total do Centro de Lazer, novos banheiros, quiosques e estufas.

A proposta é ampliar gradualmente a estrutura do espaço e criar novas possibilidades de utilização para moradores e visitantes.

Um novo espaço de lazer, esporte e turismo

A construção dos vasos e do museu representa uma nova etapa do projeto de transformação do Centro de Lazer Carlos Oscar Vaz de Almeida. A iniciativa, idealizada pelo prefeito Silvio Vaz de Almeida, busca reunir em uma mesma área atrações culturais, espaços esportivos, áreas de convivência e elementos arquitetônicos capazes de criar uma nova referência para o município.

A execução envolve engenheiros de diferentes áreas, responsáveis pela elaboração dos projetos, além de diferentes empresas que já participaram das obras por meio de processos de licitação.

Atualmente, o projeto está concentrado na execução dos vasos e do museu, enquanto outras intervenções já foram concluídas ou seguem em andamento.

Com a conclusão das obras, Jaborandi terá um complexo de lazer cada vez mais estruturado, unindo esporte, natureza, cultura e novos atrativos. Os três vasos, com quase dez metros de altura e acesso interno ao topo, estão entre os elementos que prometem dar uma nova identidade ao espaço e ampliar o potencial turístico da cidade.

articles.title: ‘GDN’ OTT release date: When and where can we watch R Madhavan’s biographical film online?
articles.summary: R Madhavan’s ‘GDN’ is now heading to OTT after its theatrical run. The biographical drama will begin streaming on Netflix from September 4. The film w.
articles.body: R Madhavan’s ‘GDN’ is now heading to OTT after its theatrical run. The biographical drama will begin streaming on Netflix from September 4. The film will also be available in Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada, giving the story of inventor GD Naidu a wider audience across India. The streaming platform officially announced the release with the line, “Oru manushan oda vaazhkai indha naatu oda varalaaru (A man's life is the history of this country),” highlighting the importance of the man whose life inspired the film.‘GDN’ OTT release brings GD Naidu’s story to a wider audienceThe OTT premiere comes as the next major chapter for ‘GDN,’ which tells the story of one of Tamil Nadu’s most celebrated inventors. Directed by Krishnakumar Ramakumar, the film traces the journey of GD Naidu as he chases new ideas and innovations despite resistance from powerful authorities. His determination to move forward despite repeated obstacles forms the central theme of the story. With its digital release, the film now has an opportunity to reach viewers who may have missed it during its theatrical run.R Madhavan leads a strong cast in the GD Naidu biopicMadhavan plays the title role and has also backed the film as a producer along with his wife Sarita. The collaboration marks another biographical project involving the production house and the actor after the 2022 film ‘Rocketry: The Nambi Effect.’ ‘GDN’ also features Sathyaraj, Jayaram, Thambi Ramaiah, Priyamani and Dushara Vijayan in important roles.From a modest theatrical run to a new OTT journey‘GDN’ was released in theatres on August 7 alongside Arun Matheswaran’s DC, starring Lokesh Kanagaraj and Wamiqa Gabbi. However, the film did not achieve the expected results at the box office. According to a trade report by Sacnilk, it grossed around Rs 6.32 crore worldwide. While its theatrical journey remained limited, the Netflix release could give Madhavan’s film a fresh start. More importantly, the digital platform may bring renewed attention to the extraordinary life and legacy of GD Naidu, whose story remains at the heart of ‘GDN.’Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Suriya’s EXPENSIVE car collection: From BMW i7 to Range Rover, THESE are the luxury cars in ‘Vishwanath And Sons’ actor’s garage
articles.summary: Apart from acting and being a seasoned star of Tamil film industry, Suriya has made a name for himself through his fondness for expensive cars. In the.
articles.body: Apart from acting and being a seasoned star of Tamil film industry, Suriya has made a name for himself through his fondness for expensive cars. In the course of his life, the actor has assembled quite a collection of luxurious sedans, electric cars, and SUVs. His collection includes some of the biggest names in the automobile world, with models from Jaguar, Audi, Toyota, BMW and Land Rover. The reported prices of these cars also show the scale of Suriya’s luxury collection.Suriya’s luxury cars include Jaguar, Audi, and Toyota VellfireSuriya’s reported car collection begins with the Jaguar XJL, which is said to be worth around Rs 1.11 crore. The actor also owns an Audi e-tron 55 Quattro, reportedly priced at around Rs 1.25 crore. Another luxury car in the garage of Suriya is Toyota Vellfire VIP Executive Lounge with a price estimated at about Rs 1.50 crore. The MPV in question is known for spacious interiors and executive comfort; therefore, it is widely preferred by celebrities.BMW i7 and Range Rover complete Suriya’s high-end car collectionAt the higher end of Suriya’s reported collection are the BMW i7 and Land Rover Range Rover Vogue SE. The BMW i7 is estimated to cost around Rs 2.16 crore and adds an electric luxury sedan to his garage. The Range Rover Vogue SE is reportedly the most expensive car in the collection, with an estimated price of around Rs 2.47 crore. With these vehicles, Suriya’s garage covers everything from premium electric cars and executive sedans to luxury SUVs. The collection has also become an interesting part of the actor’s lifestyle profile among his fans.Suriya’s latest releases ‘Karuppu’ and ‘Vishwanath And Sons’ strengthen his comebackSuriya’s professional journey has also entered an important phase with his recent releases ‘Karuppu’ and ‘Vishwanath And Sons.’ ‘Karuppu,’ directed by RJ Balaji, marked a major theatrical outing for the actor and went on to become a box office success. The film’s performance helped Suriya regain momentum after a few setbacks. He was also seen in ‘Vishwanath And Sons,’ directed by Venky Atluri, which arrived in theatres on August 14. The film, featuring Suriya alongside Mamitha Baiju, Radhika Sarathkumar and Raveena Tandon, has added another successful release to his recent filmography.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: In 1994, Brad Pitt bought this HAUNTED Los Angeles mansion and loved it despite the strange activities; decades later, he sold the property for $39 million
articles.summary: In 1994, Brad Pitt bought a stunning haunted mansion in Los Angeles which he cherished despite its eerie reputation. Former owner Elvira shares her supernatural experiences in the house that led to the actor's fascination with its architectural beauty. Pitt sold the property for $39 million decades later.
articles.body: They say every house comes with its own story, and Brad Pitt’s former LA mansion was no different, except for one thing: this tale had supernatural characters. In 1994, Brad Pitt bought a beautiful Los Angeles mansion, and its history was not limited to architectural marvels. According to the former owner of the house, the one who sold the mansion to Brad Pitt, confessed that the property was HAUNTED! Interestingly, the ‘F1’ fame actor wasn’t kept in the dark and was told about the spooky reputation of the house. However, it seems Pitt doesn’t scare easily; if anything, it made him fall more for the LA mansion.What is the story behind Brad Pitt’s ‘haunted’ Los Angeles mansion?Pitt reportedly bought the LA mansion for $1.7 millions. Before Brad Pitt, the mansion was owned by Cassandra Peterson, best known as 'Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.' While speaking to PEOPLE in an old interview, Elvira shared that she warned Brad Pitt about the haunted mansion, but the actor was ‘very excited’ and, if anything, he ‘loved it.’"We were just kind of warning him that a lot of weird things have been going on there in the house since we moved in," Elvira said before sharing, "And he was very excited about that. He thought that was really cool."Elaborating further, she explained what she experienced at the house. "I've seen people walking around upstairs, for example, real people just walking. One time [a ghost was] sitting downstairs in front of the fireplace, once walking into my bedroom and back out," she recalled."We saw a person floating around at the bottom of the pool, things like that," Elvira said, sharing another incident.She knew her reputation always entered the room before her, and thus, she added, “"I know that sounds nutty. I'm Elvira. I know you expect that from me, right? I don't have hallucinations, I wasn't high and I can't explain those things."According to Elvira’s account, she and her ex-husband, musician Mark Pierson, experienced paranormal activities soon after they moved into the 29-room mansion. They called a priest to do an exorcism. “I had all kinds of things because it was really getting to a point of like, 'I don't know if I can continue to live here,’” she said.Why did Brad Pitt purchase a haunted house?The ‘Mr & Mrs Smith’ actor loved the architectural beauty of the place, and perhaps that is why he didn’t let the spooky tales scare him away. Elvira recalled, “So we were telling Brad all about that, and he loved it. I mean, there are not many buyers who that would be a selling point for, but he was like, 'Oh, that's so awesome.' I love that he appreciated the house so much. We got together like three times, I think, before he bought the house."According to Elvria, Brad Pitt was just the perfect buyer for the house because, "he's so interested in architecture and this house is just an exquisite house." The actor was in love with the solid mahogany wall panels and copper ceilings of the living room and dining room. He couldn’t get over them. If you ignore the supernatural squatters, "It was just a stunning house".Brad Pitt sold his ‘haunted’ house for $ 39 millionThe house was in rough condition, and thus, after the purchase, Brad Pitt made many renovations and even expanded the house by adding a new base. After all the redevelopment, in 2023, Brad Pitt sold the house. He had the ownership of it for nearly three decades.
